projects.title: Road Accident Severity Prediction
bullets: Built a Random Forest model in Python to predict road-accident severity from a 12,000-record police dataset, deployed locally for testing.
Cleaned and explored the accident dataset with pandas, working through inconsistent fields before feature selection could stabilize model performance.

projects.title: Web App Flight Price
bullets: Developed a Flask web app serving a Random Forest flight-price model, deploying the pairing to Heroku for public use.
Reused patterns from the accident-severity project, translating a web development background into building this deployable prediction service.

leadership.title: Co-founder
bullets: After noticing the flight-price project relied on a model treated as a black box, started a peer reading group on evaluation methods.
Later extended that curiosity to text data, prototyping a news-category classifier, and found debugging language models more engaging than building interfaces.
